item.muzzle_guard.muzzle.desc: Wear in the face trinket slot. Blocks mouth-related animations and replaces ordinary chat with muffled syllables.
item.muzzle_guard.locked_muzzle.desc: Wear in the face trinket slot. Unlocked by default; bind and toggle it with a key.
item.muzzle_guard.collar.desc: Wear in the necklace trinket slot.
message.muzzle_guard.equip_failed: Could not equip: the matching trinket slot may already be occupied.
item.muzzle_guard.locked_collar.desc: Wear in the necklace trinket slot. Unlocked by default; bind and toggle it with a key.
item.muzzle_guard.key.desc: Use on yourself or another player to bind an unbound padlocked trinket; use it again to toggle the bound trinket's lock.
message.muzzle_guard.key_bound_to: This key is now bound to %s.
message.muzzle_guard.key_bound_elsewhere: %s is bound to a different key.
message.muzzle_guard.key_no_target: The target has no unbound padlocked trinket or trinket bound to this key.
message.muzzle_guard.key_no_trinkets: Could not read the player's trinket inventory.
message.muzzle_guard.key_error: The key action failed. See the local game log at logs/latest.log.
message.muzzle_guard.master_key_unlocked: The master key removed the binding and unlocked the trinket.
item.muzzle_guard.master_key.desc: Administrator tool: removes a padlocked trinket's binding and unlocks it.
item.muzzle_guard.shock_controller.desc: First use binds a player and the collar they are wearing; later uses deal 1 damage. If they go offline or remove/change the collar, the next use unbinds the controller.
message.muzzle_guard.controller_no_colla: The target is not wearing a collar or padlocked collar.
message.muzzle_guard.controller_collar_l: The padlocked collar is still locked. Unlock it first or hold its matching key to bind.
message.muzzle_guard.controller_bound: The shock controller is bound to %1$s (collar ID: %2$s).
message.muzzle_guard.controller_unbound: The target is offline or removed/changed the collar; the shock controller is now unbound.
message.muzzle_guard.controller_shocked: You used the shock controller on %s.
message.muzzle_guard.controller_shocked_: You were punished by the shock controller.
message.muzzle_guard.leash_requires_coll: This player must be wearing a collar to be led.
message.muzzle_guard.leash_already_attac: This player is already being led by someone else.
message.muzzle_guard.leash_cannot_lead_w: You cannot lead another player while you are being led.
message.muzzle_guard.leash_already_leadi: You are already leading another player.
message.muzzle_guard.leash_auto_released: Your lead was released because the collar was removed or you changed dimensions.
Your lead to %s was released because the collar was removed or dimensions changed.
message.muzzle_guard.leash_too_far: The lead broke because you moved too far away.
message.muzzle_guard.leash_too_far_holde: The lead to %s broke because you moved too far away.
item.muzzle_guard.lockbox_photo.desc: A keepsake of a cherished bond, refusing to break the promise between you.
